1
The Seed

not a blank page.
Every epic begins with a simple premise. Enter your title and a few paragraphs of your story's core conflict.
* AI Grounding ensures your intent is respected
* Define genre, tone, and character roles early
2
Planning

come together.
SweetStory takes your initial concepts and helps you build a solid foundation. It plans every scene, character arc, and plot point with you.
This isn't just an outline—it's a complete roadmap where every detail has a place.
![Product UI Screenshot](https://sweetstory.ai/ui/IMG_1546.PNG)
![Product UI Screenshot](https://sweetstory.ai/ui/IMG_1556.PNG)
3
Organization

you write.
Your Story Spine is a live dashboard for your world. Track word counts, perspectives, and key events across every chapter in one clean view.
Consistency
Know exactly how a change in one chapter affects the rest.
Momentum
Focus on one scene at a time to keep your writing moving.
4
Writing

knows your world.
Just write. Our AI remembers your character names, magic rules, and past events so you don't have to keep a separate wiki.
* No more contradictions in your character histories
* Consistent tone throughout your entire book
* A clean, focused reading mode for reviews
![Product UI Screenshot](https://sweetstory.ai/ui/IMG_1560.PNG)

Every feature is designed to keep you focused on the story.

No more manual spreadsheets. Your characters and world details are tracked automatically as you write.

Find plot holes before they happen. See how a change in the beginning affects your ending instantly.

Our AI understands your specific lore, ensuring consistency across every single page.
The Future of IP

We believe the book of the future isn't just a static file—it's an interactive world. By organizing fiction as a structured system, we allow stories to be explored and adapted with perfect consistency.
SweetStory is built for this transition. We give authors the tools to build deep, complex universes that were previously impossible to track.
